question.prompt: A manufacturer built a machine which will address \(500\) envelopes in \(8\) minutes. He wishes to build another machine so that when both are operating together they will address \(500\) envelopes in \(2\) minutes. The equation used to find how many minutes \(x\) it would require the second machine to address \(500\) envelopes alone is:

solutions.explanation:
Treat addressing \(500\) envelopes as one complete job. The first machine completes \(1/8\) of this job per minute. If the second machine takes \(x\) minutes alone, where \(x>0\), it completes \(1/x\) of the job per minute.

Together they must complete one job in \(2\) minutes, so their combined rate is \(1/2\) job per minute. Their amounts of work in the same minute add, giving
\[
\frac18+\frac1x=\frac12.
\]
This is the requested equation, choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
solutions.title: Add the machines' work rates
